name: cad-studio
description: CAD Studio - a standalone, AI-ready architectural 2D CAD application, and CAD Copilot - an AI assistant that docks beside the CAD and drives it

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cadstudio/desktop && npm run build -w @cadstudio/copilot
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @cadstudio/desktop && npm run test:e2e -w @cadstudio/copilot
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
